subject: Retention & Backup Visibility — evidence request for regulatory audit
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@greenbank.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@greenbank.com
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: retention/backups evidence for upcoming regulator audit

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing for a regulatory compliance audit the week of Sep 22 that will review our third-party data handling controls. The audit team has asked us to provide:

- A manifest of backups and snapshots that contain GreenBank customer data (logical IDs: GB-*).
- Retention schedules for those backups (how long snapshots are retained in each region).
- Evidence of deletion/erase propagation for items removed as part of customer-initiated data erasure requests (sample IDs provided below).
- A short summary of Disaster Recovery retention windows and the procedures that ensure deleted data does not persist in restore points.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a packaged evidence bundle (PDFs + manifests + signed attestation) by EOD Sep 19? For scope, start with the US region snapshots and the three customer IDs: GB-11822, GB-11823, GB-11824.

Thanks — appreciate a clear timeline.

Elena Martinez
Director, Vendor Risk Management
GreenBank

Attachments: audit_scope_greenbank.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@greenbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention/backups evidence for upcoming regulator audit

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up. Confirming receipt and scope.

Quick plan:
1) Marissa will assemble export-friendly PDF summaries (retention tables + policy excerpts).
2) Grace will pull region-specific snapshot manifests and the deletion proof logs for the sample IDs.
3) I'll compile a brief attestation and upload a single zip with a manifest to a secure Drive link.

- Do you want evidence for both hosted and dedicated deployments for GreenBank, or only the hosted instances?
- For deletion evidence, do you accept audit traces (tombstone + replica expunge timestamps) or do you need cryptographic verification (key-rotation logs) as well?

cc: Marissa, Grace — looping you in.

Cheers,

Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@greenbank.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention/backups evidence for upcoming regulator audit

Hi Elena — looping in the technical details below so your audit team can review format expectations. Short answers first: we will include hosted-instance artifacts only (GreenBank currently uses hosted API for production). If you need Dedicated evidence, flag that and we'll expand scope (it adds a 2–3 day lead).

What we'll include in the package:
- Snapshot manifest (CSV) with snapshot_id, creation_ts, region, model_shard_ids, logical customer tags (GB-11822 etc.).
- Retention policy extracted as PDF (backup_retention_plan.pdf) showing default retention windows and any customer overrides.
- Deletion propagation traces: tombstone creation time, replica-expunge job log timestamps, and snapshot chain hygiene notes (which snapshots were excluded from restores after deletion).
- A human-readable manifest + signed attestation (PDF) describing procedures and the person responsible.

Format details for the deletion traces: we will provide an event timeline per sample ID with ISO timestamps and region tags. Example line: "GB-11822 — tombstone created 2024-11-20T03:15:12Z — replica expunge job completed 2024-11-20T03:47:01Z (us-west1)".

For the auditor: evidence types we can produce today:
- Logs and manifests (CSV/PDF) — recommended and included.
- Signed attestation from Redwood infra lead — included.
- KMS key rotation logs / HSM attestations — available but require a compliance request flow (we can provide but would need approval from our security team; timeline +2 business days).

Please confirm if log-level traces are sufficient or if you require key-level cryptographic evidence. Also confirm whether the three sample IDs cover the auditor's needs or if they want a random sample of 10 accounts.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: backup_retention_plan.pdf (PDF)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@greenbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention/backups evidence for upcoming regulator audit — package delivered

Elena — attached is the package we discussed. Contents are summarized in manifest.txt inside the ZIP and accessible via the secure Drive folder below.

Package highlights:
- GreenBank-retention-evidence-2025.zip (manifest.txt + PDFs + per-ID event timelines)
- backup_retention_plan.pdf (policy excerpts and retention tables)
- Per-ID deletion timelines for GB-11822, GB-11823, GB-11824 (CSV + human-readable PDF)
- Signed attestation (Marissa Cole, Redwood infra lead)

Notes and scope clarifications: this package covers hosted production instances only (us-west1 primary, us-east1 replica). It includes tombstone + replica-expunge timestamps and snapshot exclusion notes demonstrating that deleted logical objects are not included in any new restore points after the recorded expunge. We did not include KMS key rotation artifacts in this first pass; those are available upon formal security evidence request.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3C-greenbank-evidence
HubSpot: HS-Deal-4237

Next steps: please confirm the auditor accepts the artifacts as-is. If they need KMS/HSM-level crypto proofs we'll open the compliance access flow (ETA 2 business days). Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if they want to walk through the manifests.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: GreenBank-retention-evidence-2025.zip (manifest.txt, PDFs)
